context: MINISTRATION Acute coronary syndrome ( 2.1 ) – Initiate clopidogrel tablet, USP with a single 300-mg oral loading dose and then continue at 75 mg once daily. – Initiating clopidogrel tablet, USP without a loading dose will delay establishment of an antiplatelet effect by several days.

DOSAGE FORMS AND STRENGTHS 75 mg tablets: Pink, round, biconvex, film-coated tablets debossed with "W 314" on one side and plain on other. 300 mg tablets: Pink, modified capsule shaped, biconvex, film-coated tablets debossed with "W 315" on one side and plain on other. Tablets: 75 mg,
